problems.s: 1) Tangaza kwenye Social Welfare (ofisi ya wilaya) — ni wajibu wao; 2) TASAF/PSSN: nenda ofisi ya kata kwa usajili; 3) Shule za kata: mwalimu mkuu + fee exemptions (Pwani/Dodoma pia WFP shule); 4) NGO: Save the Children TZ, Child in the Sun (Dar)
1) Uzeeni: TASAF/Ofisi ya wilaya; 2) Ulemavu: National Council for Persons with Disabilities (NCPD) — ofisi ya mkoa; 3) Lena za huduma: 116 (Child helpline), 112 (police/ems)
1) Police loss declaration (polisi station — PF3/loss report); 2) NIDA: itifaki ya kurejesha (govagent nida mode); 3) Kama dharura: temporary identification kutoka ward office

1) 112 (dharura) au 114 (ambulance); 2) Government hospital ya mkoa/wilaya inatoa huduma ya dharura BURE (Health Sector Reform); 3) NHIF/CHF: fungua ofisi ya wilaya kwa wazazi; 4) Kama huna pesa: social welfare + hospital social work unit
1) Health facility ya karibu (dispensary→health centre→hospital); 2) Tanzania Medicines & Medical Devices Authority (TMDA): dawa halali; 3) Telemedicine: E-daktari, MyDaktari (app)
1) NHIF: nhif.or.tz / ofisi ya mkoa (wafanyakazi); 2) CHF: kwa wafamilia — ofisi ya wilaya/council (TZS 30,000/mwaka familia); 3) govagent inakusaidia kujaza fomu

problems.p: Ajira: mshahara hachukuliwi / kupingwa bila sababu
problems.s: 1) Tangaza kwenye Labour Office (ofisi ya mkoa) — conciliation BURE; 2) Commission for Mediation and Arbitration (CMA); 3) Kama kampuni: Labour Commissioner; 4) Document yote: contract, payslips, messages

problems.p: Ardhi/familia: mgogoro wa eneo au urithi
problems.s: 1) Ward Tribunal (kata) — mwanzo; 2) District Land & Housing Tribunal; 3) Family: District Court; 4) Legal aid BURE: Legal and Human Rights Centre (LHRC), Tanganyika Law Society (TLS) pro bono
1) PPF: 112 au checkeni ya karibu; 2) Ethics: PCCB (114 au ofisi); 3) Legal aid: LHRC; 4) Document kila kitu (tarehe, majina, namba za kesi)

problems.p: Mkulima: mazao hayana soko / bei ndogo
problems.s: 1) Tanzania Mercantile Exchange (TME) — auction halali; 2) Warehouse Receipt System (WRS) — ofisi ya Sido; 3) Co-operative (AMCOS) ya eneo lako; 4) Soko digital: Kilimo Trust, eSoko
1) SIDO: trainings + loans za vijana; 2) NMB/CRDB: microloans; 3) Youth fund: TIB/VCUM (Vijana Uchumi); 4) govagent: BRELA + TIN + LESHA bundle (siku 1-3)
1) BRELA Business Name (ORS online, siku 1-3); 2) TIN (TRA OTRS — bure, online); 3) LESHA (council — kwa biashara ya eneo); 4) govagent inajaza zote mbili kwa dakika 30

problems.p: Mtu mzima/kijana hatoi SIM card / M-Pesa
problems.s: 1) NIDA lazima kwanza (govagent nida); 2) SIM registration: duka la kampuni (Vodacom/Airtel/Tigo) + NIDA; 3) Mobile money: NIDA + SIM

1) Usilipe zaidi — scam ya pili ('recovery agents') ni WAPYA zaidi; 2) Report: TCRA + police cybercrime unit (Interpol TZ); 3) Block + report kwenye platform; 4) Badilisha passwords + 2FA (shield.rs ina audit)
1) Parental controls: Google Family Link (Android), Screen Time (iOS); 2) Router-level: OpenDNS FamilyShield; 3) TCRA guidelines; 4) Fundi: shield audit + parent training
